```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 00:00 on the 1st of every month
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force cleanup even if no unused strings are detected'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  clean-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install any required Python dependencies for the scripts if they exist
          # Assuming the scripts are self-contained or use standard library
          # If external libs are needed, add them here (e.g., pip install -r Tools/requirements.txt)

      - name: Detect unused strings
        id: detect
        run: |
          # Run the detection script
          # The script should output the list of unused keys or exit with non-zero if none found
          # We capture the output to determine if a PR is needed
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.txt || true
          
          # Check if the file is not empty
          if [ -s unused_strings.txt ]; then
            echo "unused_count=$(wc -l < unused_strings.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "unused_strings=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "unused_count=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "unused_strings=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create cleanup PR
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_strings == 'true' || github.event.inputs.force == 'true'
        run: |
          # Create a new branch
          BRANCH_NAME="chore/cleanup-unused-strings-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
          git checkout -b $BRANCH_NAME
          
          # Run the removal script
          # This script should modify the .strings files and regenerate Strings.swift
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py
          
          # Check if there are changes
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            
            git add .
            git commit -m "chore: remove unused localization strings
            
            Automated cleanup of unused L10n strings.
            Removed $(cat unused_strings.txt | wc -l) unused keys."
            
            git push origin $BRANCH_NAME
            
            # Create Pull Request
            gh pr create \
              --title "chore: remove unused localization strings" \
              --body "## Summary
            
            This PR removes unused localization strings detected by the automated cleanup workflow.
            
            ### Changes
            - Removed unused keys from `Localizable.strings` files
            - Regenerated `Strings.swift` using SwiftGen
            
            ### Details
            The following keys were removed:
            
            \`\`\`
            $(cat unused_strings.txt)
            \`\`\`
            
            > [!NOTE]
            > This PR was created automatically by the \`clean_unused_strings.yml\` workflow." \
              --head $BRANCH_NAME \
              --base main
          else
            echo "No changes to commit."
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
